## Decision on the body's open design question

> *"whether an oracle base that is not an ancestor of the worktree's HEAD should
> be `indeterminate` rather than silently used"*

**Decision: cut the oracle at `merge-base(<resolved_base>, HEAD)` computed in
the WORKTREE — the three-dot diff base — rather than at the base ref's tip.
This dissolves the non-ancestor case by construction rather than adjudicating
it.**

Reasons:

1. **Coherence with the selection diff.** The payload under test is exactly
   `compute_touched`'s `<base>...HEAD`, whose base IS that merge base. Cutting
   the oracle there makes the oracle tree precisely "the worktree minus the
   payload" — the invariant NEW-vs-pre-existing classification actually needs.
2. **Fail direction.** Cutting at the base ref's TIP would inject commits the
   worktree does not contain. If such a commit independently reds the same node,
   the pristine run goes red and the node is STRIPPED — a false strip masking a
   genuine NEW failure. That is fail-OPEN, strictly worse than today's
   fail-closed false NEW. The merge base cannot introduce that channel.
3. **Non-ancestry becomes unreachable.** A merge base is always an ancestor of
   HEAD, so there is no "silently used non-ancestor base" state left to
   classify. The residual cases stay fail-closed as `_Indeterminate`: genuinely
   unrelated histories (no merge base exists), and a merge base absent from the
   MAIN root's object store (the scratch is materialized from `root` while the
   merge base is computed in `wt`, which can differ under
   `--worktree` / `--repo-root` fixture overrides) — probe with the existing
   `git_sha_known(root, sha)` helper (**:688**) rather than a new one.

Scope note carried to the planner: the root working tree is ALSO the pristine
venue for three other cases beyond criterion 3's degradation path
(`--no-scratch-fallback`; non-file-anchored scan-set nodes, R-F' #1337; a clean
non-sparse root, R-G' #2019), and each has the same base-skew exposure. Criterion
5 forbids changing strip semantics, so this round records the skew (a WARN plus a
JSON provenance field) for those three without altering their verdicts, and the
plan states that residual explicitly rather than leaving it silent.
Clarifier All-clear: no blocking ambiguities; design question settled autonomously (oracle = merge-base of resolved base and worktree HEAD). Proceeding to adversarial planning.
